title: Stage 5 Feature & User Story Output Schema
description: Defines the Module → Feature → UserStory hierarchy produced by Stage 5. Carries full L1/L2/L3 traceability back to SRS source documents and sections. Also supports the equivalent RFP path where L1/L2 point to RFP documents. Designed for direct ingestion by the Neo4j exporter's build_feature_story_graph() method.

schema_version.description: Schema version tag — increment on breaking changes.

mfu_id.description: Parent MFU identifier (e.g. MFU-001A). Links this output back to the Stage 4 config_naming_map.json.

module_id.description: Module identifier (e.g. MOD-ANCES). Matches the Module node already present in Neo4j.

module_name.description: Business-quality module name. Uses the DDD-quality name from Stage 2.7 module_manifest.json when available; falls back to the folder-derived name. Matches the Module.name property in Neo4j.

module_description.description: Business capability description for the module. Sourced from Stage 2.7 module_manifest.json when available; empty string otherwise. Always present — consumers do not need to cross-reference module_manifest.json.

source_path.description: Origin path of the primary SRS document, relative to project root.

l1_source.description: L1 traceability — the source document node for this derivation chain.

features.description: Ordered list of Features derived from the SRS for this MFU.

generation_metadata.description: Tracking metadata from the generator-critic run.

module_business_name.description: Refined DDD-quality domain name from Stage 2.7 module_manifest.json.

module_business_description.description: Refined business capability description from Stage 2.7 module_manifest.json.

mfu_seq.description: Zero-padded 3-digit sequence extracted from mfu_id (e.g. '001'). Used to derive Feature IDs.

technology_tag.description: Source technology paradigm (e.g. PowerBuilder, VB6, COBOL).

L1Source.description: L1 traceability node — the top-level source document.

id.description: Unique identifier for this source document node in Neo4j (e.g. SRS::MFU-001A::UIBlueprint).

path.description: File path relative to project root.

screen_id.description: SRS-derived Screen ID (e.g. FA_ANCES_EDIT_001). Present only for UIBlueprint documents.

mfu_id.description: Parent MFU ID. Enables Neo4j edge: (MFU)-[:HAS_SPEC]->(SRSDocument).

L2Section.description: L2 traceability node — a specific section, row, or event within the L1 source document. Maps to a :SRSSection node in Neo4j.

section_type.description: Type of SRS section this L2 node represents.

trace_id.description: TRCE-LOGIC trace ID linking this section back to exact source code lines.

control_name.description: Control name from S.3 table. Present for S3_ControlRow sections.

line_start.description: Source code line number where this section's logic begins. Derived from trace_id.

line_end.description: Source code line number where this section's logic ends.

page_number.description: Page number within an RFP document. Present only for RFP path L2 sections.

BoundingBox.description: Screen zone mapping for UI visualization. Maps a Feature to a named zone on the ASCII/zone map.

zone_id.description: Symbolic zone identifier (e.g. TOOLBAR_TOP, GRID_AREA, TOOLBAR_BOTTOM, OVERLAY_PANEL).

zone_label_en.description: English label for the zone, for UI tooltip display.

zone_label_jp.description: Japanese label for the zone (legacy system context).

screen_position.description: Canonical screen region for CSS-class-based rendering in the UI.

controls.description: Control names from S.3 that belong to this bounding box zone.

s3_row_refs.description: S.3 section IDs (L2 node IDs) that this bounding box encompasses.

highlight_color.description: Hex color code for UI overlay rendering.

SRSEvidence.description: Physical routing data for the UX split-window viewer. Populated deterministically by the Python Linker (v2). Fields enable exact-string highlighting, hierarchical navigation, AC-level traceability, and precision-aware Stage 5c refinement triggering.

l2_id.description: The logical L2 ID that triggered this mapping (e.g. SRS::MFU-001::S3::cmdRun).

section_anchor.description: Innermost markdown heading text of the section containing the evidence. Used as the primary scroll target by the UI viewer.

section_path.description: Ordered heading hierarchy from outermost to innermost. Provides an unambiguous navigation path in long SRS files with repeated heading names.

target_string.description: Unique discriminating substring the UI uses to locate the evidence within the section.

exact_quote.description: Verbatim text extracted from the SRS at index time. Empty string when not available.

trace_id.description: TRCE-IO-* or TRCE-LOGIC-* trace ID from the SRS appendix. Empty string when not applicable.

evidence_role.description: Semantic role of this evidence entry.

srs_document_type.description: SRS document format of the evidence file.

ac_ids.description: IDs of Acceptance Criteria whose l2_source_ref matches this evidence l2_id. Empty array when story-level only.

line_number.description: 1-based line number in the SRS file where this evidence was found. 0 when not available.

cross_ref.description: Bidirectional link to related evidence in another SRS file. Null when no cross-file relationship detected.

l2_id.description: L2 ID of the linked evidence.

file_name.description: SRS file containing the linked evidence.

line_number.description: Line number of the linked evidence.

source.description: Internal marker for inherited evidence. Value is 'inherited_from_feature' when promoted from parent feature's srs_evidence during Layer 3 inheritance.

context_snippet.description: Short text snippet surrounding the evidence in the SRS file. Populated by the linker for file-level precision fallbacks. Empty string when not available.

operation_type.description: Operation classification from the S.5 event table column (e.g. 'dispatch', 'crud', 'report'). Empty string when not applicable or unavailable.

tier.description: Evidence tier: L1 = story-specific direct evidence; L2 = feature-level inherited; L3 = S4 validation rule. Set by _hydrate_all_srs_evidence.

AcceptanceCriterion.description: Single Gherkin-format acceptance criterion. Every story must have at minimum one Happy Path, one Negative Path, and one Edge Case.

path_type.description: Classification of this AC — enforced by Critic.

examples: the user has entered a valid ancestor code in the search field
the data grid (dw_data) is populated with matching ancestor records within 3 seconds

l2_source_ref.description: L2 section ID this AC was derived from. Strengthens L3→L2 traceability at AC granularity.

UserStory.description: L3 traceability node. A single User Story derived from one or more L2 SRS sections. ID format: [MOD]-F[#]-S[#].

id.description: Story ID in format [MOD]-{MFU_SEQ}-F[#]-S[#] (e.g. ANCES-001-F1-S1). The MFU sequence discriminator (-001-) is REQUIRED — the critic Gate 1d/3 hard-fails an ID lacking it. Must be unique within the module.

as_a.description: Role performing the action. Must be a persona defined in the Persona Glossary.

i_want_to.description: The action the persona wants to perform.
examples: retrieve ancestor records by entering a family code and clicking Search

so_that.description: Business outcome — must be meaningful, not generic.
examples: I can verify the ancestor's registration details before submitting an update to the family registry

story_points.description: Fibonacci story points {2,3,5,8}. story_points=1 is NOT permitted (the generator, corrector, and critic Gate 6b all forbid it), so it is excluded from the enum. Critic hard-fails anything above 8.

acceptance_criteria.description: Minimum 3 ACs: one Happy Path, one Negative Path, one Edge Case.

l2_sources.description: L2 section IDs this story was derived from.

srs_evidence.description: Physical routing data mapping l2_sources to physical files and UI anchors. Populated by the post-generation linker.

technical_notes.description: Developer-facing notes: VB6/COBOL/PB control names, event names, API endpoints, DB2 cursors involved.
examples: Triggers w_fa_ances_infree::cb_retrieve.clicked event. Populates dw_data DataWindow. Trace: TRCE-LOGIC-w_fa_ances_infree-L433.

migration_hint.description: Optional modernisation guidance: suggested REST endpoint, React component, microservice boundary, or CQRS pattern.
examples: Map to GET /api/v1/ancestors?code={familyCode}. React: <AncestorSearchBar /> with useQuery hook.

jira_issue_key.description: L4 traceability — Jira issue key once created. Populated by CI/CD integration, not the generator.

test_case_ids.description: L4 traceability — test automation IDs. Populated by QA pipeline.

non_functional_requirements.description: NFRs implied by or directly associated with this user story. Empty array when none detected.

screens.description: #43 — legacy screen(s) this story relates to (e.g. host + popup). Each entry: {artifact_id, screen_id, controls_touched[], events_covered[]}. Join artifact_id to feature.screens[] for physical_file / type / ascii_layout_ref.

Feature.description: Mid-tier hierarchy node: Module → Feature → UserStory. Maps to a :Feature node in Neo4j. ID format: [MOD]-F[#].

id.description: Feature ID in format [MOD]-{MFU_SEQ}-F[#] (e.g. ANCES-001-F1). The MFU sequence discriminator (-001-) is REQUIRED — the critic Gate 1d/3 hard-fails an ID lacking it. Must be unique within the project.

description.description: One-paragraph description of the feature's business purpose.

source.description: Citation of the specific SRS section, screen event, or RFP section that is the primary source for this feature.
examples: SRS UIBlueprint FA_ANCES_EDIT_001, S.5 Event #1 — Search Operation

l2_sources.description: L2 section IDs this Feature was derived from. Empty array allowed for infrastructure/dead-code features with no SRS traceability.

srs_evidence.description: Physical routing data mapping feature-level l2_sources to physical files and UI anchors. Populated by the post-generation linker.

bounding_box.description: Screen zone mapping for UI overlay visualization.

functions.description: Sub-functions mapped from S.5 events. Empty array for infrastructure features.

business_context.description: Legacy current state and modern target state description.

success_criteria.description: Explicit NFRs extracted from SRS. Empty array when none present.

is_infrastructure.description: True if this feature is a system-level utility with no direct user-visible business value.

srs_section_scope.description: List of all SRS sections covering this MFU. Used by Stage 5b for story derivation context.

condensation_note.description: Required when is_infrastructure=true. Also used when infrastructure artifacts are bundled alongside user-facing content.

screens.description: #43 — registry of legacy screens this feature spans. Each entry: {artifact_id, screen_id, physical_file, type, role, srs_file, is_focal, ascii_layout_ref}.

GenerationMetadata.description: Tracks the generator-critic loop outcome for audit and debugging. additionalProperties is true: this is a diagnostic block, so new audit fields (e.g. relaxed-gates / schema-error markers) may be added without breaking the schema.

generator_model.description: LLM model used for generation (e.g. claude-opus-4-6).

iteration_count.description: Number of generator iterations performed (Stage 5a + 5b combined).

final_status.description: Final verdict. PASS = critic approved; PASS_RELAXED_GATES = framework/menu/ancestor feature accepted with business-value gates relaxed (#20); FAIL_HALLUCINATION = a GROUNDING gate failed (9a SRS-contradiction / 5f ref-validity / 8a artifact-grounding) — content not grounded in the SRS, NEVER eligible for relaxed gates (#31); FAIL_MAX_RETRIES = best-effort written; FAIL_NO_PARSEABLE_OUTPUT = skeleton written; FAIL_SCHEMA_INVALID = output failed schema validation, quarantined (#19).

critic_feedback_log.description: FEEDBACK from each critic iteration, for audit trail.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of final successful generation.

correction_applied.description: True when at least one Stage 5b correction pass was applied after the initial generation.

status_detail.description: Structured audit detail for the generator-critic loop run. Fields vary by run path.

fallback_reason.description: Diagnostic reason string set by the deterministic fallback path (e.g. 'call1=mode4; call2=mode4').

failure_reason.description: Diagnostic reason string for a non-PASS terminal status.

schema_error.description: #19 — captured JSON-schema validation error when final_status=FAIL_SCHEMA_INVALID.

gate_profile.description: #20 — 'framework' when the feature was classified as a reusable framework/menu/ancestor unit and graded with relaxed business-value gates.

framework_focal.description: #20 — the focal artifact id that matched a framework pattern (e.g. 'menu_dw', 'uo_anc_dw').

relaxed_gates.description: #20 — list of gate groups relaxed for this framework feature (e.g. business value, controls).

review_guidance.description: #38 (MVP) — deterministic, PM-facing corrective-action guidance for this feature's final_status. Rendered by the review UI at feature level.

approve_as_is_allowed.description: Drives the one-click-approve button. Hard-False for FAIL_HALLUCINATION / FAIL_SCHEMA_INVALID.

guideline.description: Human-readable corrective-action hint shown to the PM.

failure_summary.description: Verbatim critic feedback (authoritative reason); present for non-clean statuses.

flagged_story_ids.description: Story IDs the critic specifically flagged (best-effort), for pinpointing in the tree.

gate_reference.description: #38b — plain-English help for the Critic gate(s) referenced in failure_summary (failed gates only, full-catalog fallback). Rendered as help/tooltips by the review UI.

FeatureFunction.description: A sub-operation mapped 1:1 to an S.5 event. Sets the ceiling for Stage 5b story generation.

label.description: Concise business sub-feature TITLE (one line) using domain vocabulary; verbatim event token retained in trailing parentheses for traceability.

description.description: Optional 2-3 sentence business explanation of the sub-feature, grounded in the S.5 event evidence. Carried forward from the Stage-5a feature manifest (function-label polish pass); absent when polish is disabled.

l2_source_ref.description: L2 ID of the S.5 event, S.3 control, or API endpoint this function maps to.

function_label.description: Legacy alias for label — emitted by older LLM generations. Normalized to label by the pipeline. Kept here for backward compatibility with pre-fix outputs.

BusinessContext.description: Describes the legacy baseline and the modern target state.

current_state.description: Description of the legacy artifact and its current user behavior.

target_state.description: Description of the modern equivalent (React component, REST endpoint, microservice).

NonFunctionalRequirement.description: A non-functional requirement implied by the SRS (security, performance, data integrity, audit). May be explicit in SRS or derived from technical evidence (e.g. unhandled SQL injection exposure).

requirement.description: Plain-text NFR statement (e.g. 'All API calls must complete within 2 seconds under 95th-percentile load').

derived_from.description: Source of this NFR: 'explicit_srs' when stated in SRS text, 'implied_gap' when inferred from technical evidence or best practice.
